thread_spec.family: D8 custom trapezoidal matched pair with relieved female root; not ISO metric
thread_spec.print_orientation: Screw knob flat on bed, shaft upright; nut axis upright

diagnosis: All 831 original mesh boundary edges fell at the 0.05 mm overlap of the smooth 8 mm diameter shank with the swept helical crest. Replacing the coincident cylindrical surfaces with a 1 mm tapered runout gives a watertight one-component mesh.
limits: Geometric and mesh validation only; printed strength and fit not qualified.
